source_grounding.source_excerpt: lib/segment/src/types.rs:3793-3826 — #[serde(deny_unknown_fields, rename_all = "snake_case")] pub struct Filter { /// At least one of those conditions should match #[validate(nested)] #[serde(default, with = "MaybeOneOrMany", skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] #[schemars(with = "MaybeOneOrMany<Condition>")] pub should: Option<Vec<Condition>>, /// At least minimum amount of given conditions should match #[validate(nested)] #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] pub min_should: Option<MinShould>, /// All conditions must match #[validate(nested)] #[serde(default, with = "MaybeOneOrMany", skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] #[schemars(with = "MaybeOneOrMany<Condition>")] pub must: Option<Vec<Condition>>, /// All conditions must NOT match #[validate(nested)] #[serde(default, with = "MaybeOneOrMany", skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] #[schemars(with = "MaybeOneOrMany<Condition>")] pub must_not: Option<Vec<Condition>>, } | lib/segment/src/common/utils.rs:80-107 — /// Deserializer helper for `Option<Vec<T>>` that allows deserializing both single and an array of values. /// Use via `#[serde(with = "MaybeOneOrMany")]` and `#[schemars(with="MaybeOneOrMany<T>")]` field attributes pub struct MaybeOneOrMany<T>(pub Option<Vec<T>>); impl<'de, T: Deserialize<'de>> MaybeOneOrMany<T> { pub fn deserialize<D>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Option<Vec<T>>, D::Error> where D: serde::Deserializer<'de> { use serde_untagged::UntaggedEnumVisitor; UntaggedEnumVisitor::new() .unit(|| Ok(None)) .seq(|x| x.deserialize().map(Some)) .map(|x| x.deserialize().map(|x| vec![x]).map(Some)) .deserialize(deserializer) } } | lib/segment/src/types.rs:3784-3788 — pub struct MinShould { #[validate(nested)] pub conditions: Vec<Condition>, pub min_count: usize, } (conditions NOT MaybeOneOrMany — same-family contrast) | lib/api/src/rest/schema.rs:564-566 — /// Filter conditions - return only those points that satisfy the specified conditions. #[validate(nested)] pub filter: Option<Filter>
source_grounding.call_chain_traced: actix route src/actix/api/query_api.rs:30 #[post("/collections/{collection_name}/points/query")] query_points(request: Json<QueryRequest>) -> lib/api/src/rest/schema.rs:596 QueryRequest{internal(flattened): QueryRequestInternal, shard_key} -> :566 filter: Option<Filter> -> lib/segment/src/types.rs:3794 Filter.should/must/must_not with #[serde(with="MaybeOneOrMany")] -> lib/segment/src/common/utils.rs:94-107 deserialize: .map(|x| x.deserialize().map(|x| vec![x]).map(Some)) coerces the single JSON object into a one-element Condition vec (filter applied, not dropped). The paired #[schemars(with="MaybeOneOrMany<Condition>")] generates the anyOf[Condition, Vec<Condition>, null] schema verifiably present in docs/redoc/v1.18.x/openapi.json — the same tolerance is published into the documentation the contract cites (prefetch at schema.rs:553 uses the same helper, confirming an API-wide pattern). MinShould.conditions is a bare Vec<Condition> (no helper), so a string/object there would be a genuine 400 — the never-executed V400d leg targets the one clause family member without the tolerance.
